user.description:
Since 1996, JAŸ-Z has revolutionized the entertainment industry. A multi-award-winning artist and Songwriters Hall of Fame inductee, he’s known not only for his iconic lyrics but also for his unmatched longevity and impact on culture. In 2008, JAY-Z co-founded preeminent global entertainment company, Roc Nation.

An entrepreneur at heart, JAY-Z has built and co-owns several influential brands and businesses, including D’usse, Paper Planes, the legendary 40/40 Club, streaming platform TIDAL, and luxury champagne Armand de Brignac.

With 25 GRAMMY Awards to his name, JAY-Z made history as the first solo hip-hop artist inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. His accolades also include multiple American Music Awards, BET Hip Hop Awards, Billboard Music Awards, and the prestigious Dr. Dre Impact Award, recognizing his lasting influence on music, culture, and the industry.

Beyond entertainment, JAY-Z uses his platform to drive meaningful change. He co-founded the Shawn Carter Foundation with his mother, Dr. Gloria Carter and supports criminal justice reform through the REFORM Alliance.
